## 6. Reading (spec sec 6, applied to the point estimate)

(a) At realistic mean payment sizes the compiled policy equals a single cutoff at arrival. (At L1, Comp - Cutoff = +3.22 bp, 95% interval [+2.46, +4.02], margin 10 bp) The 95% interval lies inside the margin.

(b) at L2 the value share of payments above v* is 34.74%, at L3 the value share of payments above v* is 81.22%. At L3 it is at least 50%, so the following sentence is used: Rare by count, but more than half of the value lies where the policy acts. L3 is a tail sensitivity and is not used as the main basis of a conclusion.

(c) In the mean sweep, Comp - Cutoff is mean $0.2 (L1) +3.22 bp [+2.46, +4.02], mean $1 (L4) +47.50 bp [+44.93, +49.77], mean $5 (L5) +294.79 bp [+290.89, +298.38], mean $49.5 (L0) +622.65 bp [+618.20, +626.56]. The smallest mean at which Comp - Cutoff exceeds the margin is $1 (L4).
